title: Sequenced shadow-validation mini-release for private control plane
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build automation and runbook to perform a sequenced mini-release of control plane versions in private (VPC) deployments using read-only shadowing and KV-cache mirroring. The goal is to validate minor version compatibility and runtime behavior without impacting production traffic, provide deterministic rollback, and produce Terraform module changes that operators can run with minimal manual steps.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module updates are merged and documented: new 'shadow_release' boolean and 'shadow_slice' size parameter
Preflight runner can provision a shadow control-plane variant in a tenant's VPC with read-only traffic mirroring and KV-cache warmup script
Automated health gates evaluate p50 and p99 latency, 5xx rate, and kv-cache hit ratio; gates are configurable and recorded in control plane logs
Rollout automation can promote a shadowed variant to incremental active slices or fully roll it back within 10 minutes of a failed gate
CI job + canary simulation harness reproduces known upgrade regressions (tokenization drift, model config mismatch) and fails fast on regressions
Operational runbook (Confluence) and incident playbook are linked from the Terraform module README
tasks: Design: define shadow_release schema changes for terraform modules (inputs/outputs)
Implementation: add 'shadow' path to private control plane helm chart and arn/kms integration for logs
Runtime: implement KV-cache mirroring and prefix-warm on shadow instances
Telemetry: dashboard panels for shadow vs primary latency, errors, and kv hit ratio
Automation: orchestrator workflow to create shadow, run probes, and either cutover or tear down
Docs: Confluence runbook + Terraform usage example and rollback steps
Security: run security review and add audit log retention config
progress_updates: 2026-02-12: Ticket created. Initial design meeting notes pushed to Confluence (link below). Decided to prefer read-only traffic mirror over live split to reduce blast radius.
2026-02-18: Terraform schema drafted. Added 'shadow_release' boolean and 'shadow_slice' int (1-100). Trade-off: adding these flags complicates module interface but enables safe operator opt-in.
2026-02-24: PoC for KV-cache mirroring implemented; uses async snapshot + replay for warmup. Observed 20% shorter cold-start latency in bench runs. PR opened: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1299
2026-02-28: Telemetry gating thresholds proposed: p50 increase <= 15%, p99 increase <= 30%, 5xx delta <= 0.5%. These are conservative and will be tuned after two tenants run the mini-release.

2026-03-03: End-to-end test harness runs against local kind cluster with traffic-replay; caught a model-config edge case where feature-flag mismatch caused tokenization drift. Added preflight model-config checksum validation.
2026-03-07: Security review kickoff. KMS key usage for shadow logs validated by security. Need final sign-off on audit retention policies.

2026-03-10: First customer-sandbox run scheduled for 2026-03-15. Operator checklist and rollback playbook drafted. Assigned oncall rotation for the window. Next: finalize Terraform examples and create a canary dashboard template.
notes: Key trade-offs discussed: 1) mirror vs split traffic — chose mirror for safety; 2) automated promotion timing — keep promotion manual for first two tenants; 3) KV-cache warmup complexity vs test coverage — implemented async snapshot to balance overhead. Follow-ups: add synthetic latency-injection tests and integrate with rollout gating service.
